errors.text_span: 该图表显示了2022年7月1日至2022年8月26日期间每日新增患者人数与新闻媒体报道数目的变化趋势。
errors.evidence: Description states '每日新增患者人数' which misrepresents the left y-axis that shows daily confirmed COVID-19 cases.
Description states that July 15 had 1,600,000 cases; the figure indicated a lower number.

errors.text_span: 每日新闻报道数目的线图则波动较大，数值范围大约在500至5000之间。
errors.evidence: Description states a news report range of 500 to 5,000; the figure shows a higher possible maximum near 6,000.
The description does not effectively convey that the chart specifically represents the trend of confirmed COVID-19 cases alongside media reporting.
The description does not mention the visual differentiation of data (color distinction) among the two types of representations.
